Interpretation rule:
  This tool reports measurements and evidence-tiered warnings, not origin classifications.
  Raw UTF-8 findings are diagnostic only unless supported by linguistic encodings. v0.2 adds bit_text, Markov nulls, gap-order controls, and explicit hyphen policy.
